title: Add shopping list line formatter
description: Create a pure formatter that converts aggregated shopping-list items into markdown-ready checklist text with italicised quantity spans.
acceptance_criteria: Formatting covers empty, single, and multi-quantity branches from the spec.
Numeric formatting matches the recipe-scale display style for whole and fractional values.

execution_history.summary: Created `ShoppingListLineFormatter.swift` — a pure `enum` with a static `format(_ item: AggregatedItem) -> String` method. Covers all four branches from the spec: empty quantities (name only), single text quantity, single numeric quantity with/without unit, and multi-quantity comma-joined italic span. Numeric formatting mirrors `RecipeScale.format` exactly (whole numbers as integers, fractions up to two decimals with trailing zeros trimmed). Ran `xcodegen generate` to include the new source in the Xcode project.
